content.short: Guardian provides devastatingly effective Smart Contract security.
content.description: Guardian protects the most targeted Smart Contract applications worldwide through manual auditing and invariant testing. Smart Contract Fuzzing simulates millions of randomized and targeted transactions to probe systems for critical flaws, covering a broad spectrum of states and interactions. In every engagement, Guardian fuzzing engineers tailor a comprehensive, stateful fuzzing suite to the Smart Contract system, enabling the discovery of vulnerabilities that remain invisible to the naked eye.
